items.issue: dot TUI: a status message (L relink, commit, push, pull) is overwritten by the selected file diff when the file list is non-empty, because refresh_status() updates the file lists and their async highlight event re-renders the diff pane after _show_message. Confirmed by a TUI test (non-empty file list, unmocked DiffView, press L): the pane shows the changed.txt diff, not linked <target>. Swapping refresh_status before _show_message does not fix it. Predates PRD 00088 (src/tools/dot/tui/screens/main.py).
